catalog.agent_visibility: Complete raw materials, answers and references may be selected for an Environment; the developer controls their use.
catalog.archive_scope: Selected upstream archive; external build dependencies and separately distributed datasets are excluded.
catalog.container_strategy: Use the preserved Embecosm mirror with original provenance; admit individual programs and inputs rather than exposing the whole corpus to the agent.

corpus_contract.inputs: Some small/large inputs included; provenance and applicability vary.
corpus_contract.oracle: Per-application reference output/round-trip contracts must be audited.
corpus_contract.split_unit: Original application provenance across all benchmark suites.

catalog.purpose: Historical embedded application coverage and comparison with prior compiler autotuning literature.
qualification_gaps: The mirror is not a currently maintained upstream suite and contains heterogeneous application/input licenses.
Modern language/UB fixes and runnable oracles need per-case review.
Overlap with cBench, TACLeBench, LLVM test-suite and application sources must be grouped across all splits.
catalog.redistribution_status: Not approved for redistribution before per-component provenance and license review; public availability alone is insufficient.
catalog.size_basis: Measured HTTP response body and SHA256; logical size sums regular archive file entries, excluding filesystem allocation, submodule payloads and external datasets.
catalog.title: MiBench historical application collection

locations.label: Prepared material
locations.purpose: Independent verified source, input, data or upstream distribution.

notes: Definition migration records availability contracts, not successful acquisition, installation or execution.
